_note: KET 新话题第一批(6个)。结构:单档8句一男一女对话(♂voice:chris/♀rosie,4组问答),A2水平简单自然。待 v4pro 双卡审后 splice 为 cambridge/KET 场景。examTopics 需补 transport/sports/festivals 键(friends用family/holidays用travel/jobs用work)。

meta.title: 假期去哪玩
meta.subtitle: Holidays and travel
meta.description: KET 高频话题:聊度假、去过的地方、喜欢海边还是山里。A2 简单对话。
meta.examTip: **考法** 假期旅行是 KET 高频话题。考官常问 Do you like...? / Where did you go...? / What did you do...? 回答用一般现在时说喜好、一般过去时说经历,给 1-2 句即可。

dialogue.en: Do you like going on holiday, Lily?
dialogue.zh: 你喜欢去度假吗，莉莉？

dialogue.en: Yes, I love it! I went to the beach last summer.
dialogue.zh: 喜欢！去年夏天我去了海边。

dialogue.en: That sounds fun. What did you do there?
dialogue.zh: 听起来很好玩。你在那儿做了什么？

dialogue.en: I swam in the sea and built sandcastles with my sister.
dialogue.zh: 我在海里游泳，还和妹妹堆了沙堡。

dialogue.en: Nice! Do you prefer the beach or the mountains?
dialogue.zh: 真好！你更喜欢海边还是山里？

dialogue.en: The beach, definitely. What about you, Tom?
dialogue.zh: 肯定是海边。你呢，汤姆？

dialogue.en: I like the mountains. I went skiing there last winter.
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢山里。去年冬天我去那儿滑雪了。

dialogue.en: Wow, that sounds exciting! I'd love to try skiing.
dialogue.zh: 哇，听起来好刺激！我也想试试滑雪。

meta.title: 怎么去
meta.subtitle: Getting around
meta.description: KET 高频话题:聊怎么上学、坐什么车、喜欢的交通方式。A2 简单对话。
meta.examTip: **考法** 交通出行是 KET 常考。考官问 How do you get to...? / How long does it take? 回答用 I go by bus / on foot,时间用 It takes about... 简单直接即可。

dialogue.en: How do you get to school, Lily?
dialogue.zh: 你怎么去学校，莉莉？

dialogue.en: I usually go by bus. It takes about twenty minutes.
dialogue.zh: 我一般坐公交，大概二十分钟。

dialogue.en: Do you ever walk or ride a bike?
dialogue.zh: 你走路或骑车去过吗？

dialogue.en: Sometimes I ride my bike when the weather is nice.
dialogue.zh: 天气好的时候我有时会骑自行车。

dialogue.en: What's your favourite way to travel?
dialogue.zh: 你最喜欢的出行方式是什么？

dialogue.en: I love taking the train because I can look out of the window.
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢坐火车，因为可以看窗外的风景。

dialogue.en: Me too. How do you get to the city centre?
dialogue.zh: 我也是。你怎么去市中心？

dialogue.en: I take the underground. It's fast and never gets stuck in traffic.
dialogue.zh: 我坐地铁。又快，还不会堵车。

meta.title: 喜欢的运动
meta.subtitle: Sports and games
meta.description: KET 高频话题:聊喜欢的运动、多久做一次、和谁一起。A2 简单对话。
meta.examTip: **考法** 运动是 KET 高频话题。考官问 What sports do you like? / How often do you...? 回答用现在时说喜好和频率(once a week / every day),给个理由更好。

templates.en: I'm not very good at ___, but it's fun.

dialogue.en: What sports do you like, Lily?
dialogue.zh: 你喜欢什么运动，莉莉？

dialogue.en: My favourite sport is swimming. I go to the pool every weekend.
dialogue.zh: 我最喜欢游泳。我每个周末都去泳池。

dialogue.en: That's great. Do you play any team sports?
dialogue.zh: 真棒。你玩团队运动吗？

dialogue.en: Yes, I play basketball with my friends after school.
dialogue.zh: 玩，我放学后和朋友打篮球。

dialogue.en: How often do you practise?
dialogue.zh: 你多久练一次？

dialogue.en: About twice a week. I'm not very good, but it's really fun.
dialogue.zh: 大概一周两次。我打得不太好，但很有意思。

dialogue.en: Do you like watching sports on TV too?
dialogue.zh: 你也喜欢在电视上看比赛吗？

dialogue.en: Sometimes. I love watching football with my dad.
dialogue.zh: 有时候。我喜欢和爸爸一起看足球。

meta.title: 过节啦
meta.subtitle: Festivals and celebrations
meta.description: KET 高频话题:聊喜欢的节日、怎么庆祝、和谁一起、吃什么。A2 简单对话。
meta.examTip: **考法** 节日庆祝是 KET 常考话题。考官问 What's your favourite festival? / How do you celebrate? 回答用现在时说习俗(we eat.../ we visit...),简单具体即可。

dialogue.en: What's your favourite festival, Lily?
dialogue.zh: 你最喜欢的节日是什么，莉莉？

dialogue.en: I love Spring Festival. The whole family gets together.
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢春节。全家人都会团聚。

dialogue.en: That sounds lovely. What do you usually do?
dialogue.zh: 听起来真好。你们通常做什么？

dialogue.en: We have a big dinner and my grandma gives us red packets.
dialogue.zh: 我们吃一顿大餐，奶奶还会给我们红包。

dialogue.en: Nice! Do you eat any special food?
dialogue.zh: 真好！你们吃什么特别的食物吗？

dialogue.en: Yes, we make dumplings together. They're my favourite.
dialogue.zh: 会的，我们一起包饺子。那是我的最爱。

dialogue.en: Which festival do you like, Tom?
dialogue.zh: 你喜欢哪个节日，汤姆？

dialogue.en: I like Mid-Autumn Festival. We eat mooncakes and watch the moon.
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢中秋节。我们吃月饼，赏月亮。

meta.title: 我的好朋友
meta.subtitle: My friends
meta.description: KET 高频话题:聊好朋友、一起做什么、朋友是什么样的人。A2 简单对话。
meta.examTip: **考法** 朋友是 KET 高频话题。考官问 Tell me about your best friend / What do you do together? 回答用现在时描述朋友(She's kind / funny)和一起做的事,给 1-2 句即可。

dialogue.en: Tell me about your best friend, Lily.
dialogue.zh: 跟我说说你最好的朋友吧，莉莉。

dialogue.en: My best friend is Emma. We've known each other since we were six.
dialogue.zh: 我最好的朋友是艾玛。我们六岁就认识了。

dialogue.en: What do you like doing together?
dialogue.zh: 你们喜欢一起做什么？

dialogue.en: We love drawing and watching cartoons at the weekend.
dialogue.zh: 我们喜欢周末一起画画、看动画片。

dialogue.en: She sounds fun. What's she like?
dialogue.zh: 她听起来很有意思。她是什么样的人？

dialogue.en: She's really kind and always makes me laugh.
dialogue.zh: 她非常善良，总能逗我笑。

dialogue.en: How often do you see each other?
dialogue.zh: 你们多久见一次？

dialogue.en: Almost every day at school. We sit next to each other.
dialogue.zh: 几乎每天在学校见。我们坐在一起。

meta.title: 长大想做什么
meta.subtitle: Jobs and dreams
meta.description: KET 高频话题:聊长大想做的工作、为什么、喜欢的科目。A2 简单对话。
meta.examTip: **考法** 未来工作是 KET 常考话题。考官问 What do you want to be? / Why? 回答用 I want to be a... because... 说梦想和简单理由,现在时即可。

templates.en: I want to do this because ___.

dialogue.en: What do you want to be when you grow up, Lily?
dialogue.zh: 你长大想做什么，莉莉？

dialogue.en: I want to be a doctor. I'd like to help sick people.
dialogue.zh: 我想当医生。我想帮助生病的人。

dialogue.en: That's a great job. Why do you want to do it?
dialogue.zh: 那是个很棒的工作。你为什么想做呢？

dialogue.en: Because my mum is a nurse, and I want to help people like her.
dialogue.zh: 因为我妈妈是护士，我想像她一样帮助别人。

dialogue.en: What's your favourite subject at school?
dialogue.zh: 你在学校最喜欢的科目是什么？

dialogue.en: I love science. It helps me understand how things work.
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢科学。它帮我理解事物是怎么运作的。

dialogue.en: What about you, Tom? What do you want to be?
dialogue.zh: 你呢，汤姆？你想做什么？

dialogue.en: I want to be a pilot. I've always dreamed of flying planes.
dialogue.zh: 我想当飞行员。我一直梦想着开飞机。
